zh-CN.title: 隧道掘进速度估算
zh-CN.intro: 输入孔深、利用率、工序耗时、计划循环数、有效日工时、施工天数与目标长度；同时给出整循环与跨日平均日进尺、月进尺与工期，并提示理想假设。
note: 计划循环数须为 1–6 的整数，小数会被拒绝
单循环总耗时须大于 0；为 0 时提示缺少工序数据
整循环模型按 floor(日工时÷循环时间)；跨日平均模型允许单循环跨日
月进尺与工期按连续施工估算，未计停工、检修、地质突变与节假日

en-US.title: Tunnel Advance Rate
en-US.intro: Enter hole depth, utilization, process times, planned cycles, effective daily work hours, construction days and target length. See both full-cycle and cross-day average daily advance, monthly advance and duration, with stated ideal assumptions.
notes: Planned cycles must be an integer from 1 to 6; decimals are rejected
Total cycle time must be greater than 0; zero means missing process data
Full-cycle model uses floor(work hours ÷ cycle time); cross-day model allows a cycle to span days
Monthly advance and duration assume continuous work; stoppages, maintenance, geological changes and holidays are excluded

zh-CN.title: 隧道衬砌厚度计算
zh-CN.intro: 按围岩级别与跨度估厚，需输入开挖高度并选择断面形状与衬砌范围，展示计算周长与每延米二衬用量；缺少必要参数时不输出用量。
note: 开挖跨度 B 与高度 H 均须大于 0，否则清空旧结果
直墙半圆拱要求 H ≥ B/2，矩形断面无此限制
计算周长按内轮廓简化，用量 V=h₂×P×1 m，未计超挖、损耗与配筋体积
经验估算不能替代荷载—结构计算、配筋验算与结算计量

en-US.title: Tunnel Lining Thickness
en-US.intro: Estimate lining thickness from rock class and span. Enter excavation height and select section shape and lining range; the calculated perimeter and secondary lining volume per metre are shown. Missing geometry produces no volume.
notes: Both span B and height H must be greater than 0; otherwise old results are cleared
A straight-wall semicircular arch requires H ≥ B/2; rectangular sections have no such limit
Perimeter is an simplified inner-profile length; V=h₂×P×1 m excludes overbreak, losses and rebar volume
Empirical estimates do not replace load-structure analysis, reinforcement design or settlement measurement

zh-CN.title: 隧道支护参数设计
zh-CN.intro: 输入围岩级别、跨度、高度与断面/支护范围，按经验系数估算锚杆长度、间距、喷层厚度与每延米锚杆数；支护展开长度按选中几何计算，结果仅为方案粗估。
note: 跨度与高度须大于 0，否则清空结果卡片与明细
半圆拱要求 H ≥ B/2，不满足时清除旧结果并提示
展开长度按矩形顶板+侧壁 / 矩形全周长 / 半圆拱+直墙分别计算
实际设计须结合围岩力学参数、地应力与监控量测

en-US.title: Tunnel Support Design
en-US.intro: Estimate bolt length, spacing, shotcrete thickness and bolts per metre from rock class, span, height and support geometry. Developed length follows the selected shape; results are preliminary estimates only.
notes: Span and height must be greater than 0; otherwise result cards and details are cleared
A semicircular arch requires H ≥ B/2; otherwise old results are cleared with an explanation
Developed length is computed separately for rectangular roof+walls, full rectangle and arch+straight walls
Formal design must consider rock mechanics, in-situ stress and monitoring data

zh-CN.title: 隧道通风计算
zh-CN.intro: 按控制风速法或 CO 稀释法估算需风量，按输入的有效通风长度计算换气次数；可设运行/备用风机台数与漏风余量，风机均分仅为配置示例。
note: 控制风速法必须填写有效通风长度 L，换气次数 n=Q/(A×L)
风机台数、备用台数与漏风余量均参与校验，均分不是选型结论
选型须结合风管漏风、系统阻力、性能曲线、并联效率与海拔/温度修正
本页不计算施工人员需风量，人员供风须按适用规范另行设计

en-US.title: Ventilation Calc
en-US.intro: Estimate required airflow by control velocity or CO dilution, and compute air changes from the entered effective ventilation length. Running/standby fan counts and leakage margin are configurable; equal splitting is only a configuration example.
notes: Control-velocity mode requires effective ventilation length L; air changes n=Q/(A×L)
Fan count, standby count and leakage margin are validated; equal splitting is not a selection conclusion
Selection must consider duct leakage, system resistance, fan curves, parallel efficiency and altitude/temperature corrections
Personnel airflow is not computed here and must be designed separately to applicable standards

zh-CN.title: 隧道瓦斯监测参考
zh-CN.intro: 按瓦斯浓度、监测位置、氧含量与可配置阈值给出参考分级；5%~16% 是否可爆须结合氧含量与点火源，页面不对单一浓度作绝对安全断言。
note: 报警与撤人/断电阈值默认 0.5%/1.0%，仅为示例，须按适用地区与规范设定
氧气浓度可留空，留空时不断言可爆或不可爆
单次测点不能代表全断面，局部积聚与测点失真须多点复核
本页不能替代现场监测、瓦斯检查制度与应急规程

en-US.title: Tunnel Gas Monitoring Reference
en-US.intro: Classify by methane concentration, monitoring location, oxygen level and configurable thresholds. Whether 5%–16% can explode depends on oxygen and ignition source; a single concentration is never asserted safe.
notes: Alarm and evacuation/power-cut thresholds default to 0.5%/1.0% as examples only; set them to the applicable region and code
Oxygen may be left blank; the page then does not assert explosible or non-explosible
One reading does not represent the whole section; check local accumulation and measurement error at multiple points
This page cannot replace on-site monitoring, gas inspection rules or emergency procedures
